name: Ethironal Shrine Sanctuary
desc:
The Ethironal Shrine Sanctuary is the area directly after the [Ethironal Shrine Outskirts](location:ethironal_shrine_outskirts), and takes up the majority of [Floor 1](location:the_ethironal_shrine). Notable features include powerful winds, parasite pits and rapid gain of parasites. It is infested with Bounders, Husks and Carbuncles on the ground, so you must stay on the bridges to avoid fighting powerful monsters. Sub-locations include the [Frontier Furnace](location:the_frontier_furnace).

The three Diver journals can be found here.
additional_info:
-   This is main First Floor location, since almost all the action takes place here. Generator, [Frontier Furnace](location:the_frontier_furnace), [Pilgrim's Respite](location:pilgrims_respite) and even Firfire are located in Ethironal Shrine Sanctuary.
-   The Spear of Nakti is most likely named after Naktigonis, the composer of the game’s soundtrack.
